title: The Halong Bay Project
segments: Linh, Mai, and An arrived at beautiful Halong Bay. The sun shone on the emerald water. They were excited for their 'Green Travel' project. Linh, the team leader, tried to explain everyone's jobs. But her plan was not very clear. Mai looked at An. An looked back at Mai. They both seemed a little confused about what to do first.

Because of this, their 'Green Travel' project started slowly. Mai, eager to capture the beauty, took many photos of the emerald water and limestone karsts. An tried to interview locals, but felt shy and struggled to ask questions. Linh, the team leader, felt overwhelmed trying to coordinate everyone without clear tasks.

Because of this slow start, the three friends felt frustrated. That evening, they sat down to talk. Linh said, "We need a better way to work. Our 'Green Travel' project needs clearer tasks for everyone." Mai and An nodded. Linh suggested, "We need a good plan, like project management, to divide our jobs better." They hoped this discussion would help.

After that, the friends re-assigned their project roles. Mai, with her artistic eye, focused on photography. An, now more confident, prepared questions for interviews. Linh, as team leader, coordinated everything and made a simple schedule. With clear tasks, they worked efficiently, enjoying Halong Bay's beautiful nature. Their 'Green Travel' project was finally moving forward smoothly.

After that, with clear roles and a good schedule, the team worked together perfectly. Mai captured stunning photos, An conducted excellent interviews, and Linh ensured everything ran on time. They finished their 'Green Travel' project early! Feeling proud and accomplished, they had extra time to explore the beautiful Halong Bay, enjoying their success.

Because of this, the friends spent their extra time exploring Halong Bay. They kayaked through calm waters, saw amazing caves, and watched the sunset. Linh, Mai, and An felt proud of their 'Green Travel' project and their strong teamwork. They learned that working together made everything better, creating memories they would cherish.
endWrap: Their trip to Halong Bay taught them valuable lessons about teamwork and communication. They returned home not just with a great project, but with stronger friendships and unforgettable memories.
